docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A roe deer grows up in the forest, learns its seasons and its dangers, and comes to know the creature the animals call He.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Felix Salten (1869–1945), Bambi: Eine Lebensgeschichte aus dem Walde (German), 1923, translated by Whittaker Chambers (1901–1961), 1928. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
